title: Commercial Lease Application
summary: Choose from 100 commercial lease applications for 20 business uses. Preview 1–4-page forms with matching PDF, Image, Word, and ODT downloads.
lead: Find the right application for your business use, operating stage, and level of detail.
usage_paragraphs: The PDF contains fillable application fields. Word provides editable structured fields, while ODT is an editable OpenDocument text layout. Editable versions may render differently depending on your office application and fonts.
The Image download contains every page in one full-resolution image. Use the page buttons above to inspect the individual pages before downloading.
Complete the fields relevant to the proposed premises and identify the records requested by the recipient. These are application forms; proposed terms require a separate lease.
selection_guide: Start with Business Use, then choose how much information the recipient needs. Essential is a one-page introduction. Standard adds operations, authority, rental history, a financial summary, and supporting records.

Startup focuses on a new business or organization, launch funding, projections, and management experience. Established includes three fiscal years of results, year-to-date figures, current tenancy, and references. Comprehensive expands the premises requirements and review across four pages.

All applications use US Letter portrait pages. Color designs appear first, followed by black-and-white designs. The preview and description show the actual contents and page count for each application.

title: Dog Vaccination Record
summary: Browse 100 dog vaccination record designs in color and black-and-white. Choose puppy, adoption, clinic, travel, booster, reaction, or long-term formats, with fillable PDF, editable Word, and static Image files.
lead: Choose a record for routine care, a new puppy, clinic visits, travel planning, or a dog’s longer history.
usage_paragraphs: These are personal record-keeping forms. Copy dates and product details from records supplied by your veterinary practice, and ask the clinic to confirm which entries apply to your dog.

Travel organizers help keep trip details together but do not replace official veterinary certificates, rabies documentation, or destination requirements. Confirm current travel requirements with your veterinarian and the relevant authorities.

Each design includes a fillable PDF, an editable Word document, and a static Image file. Word documents are arranged to fit one page in the checked LibreOffice render; edits or another office app may change pagination.
selection_guide: Start with the record type that matches the handoff or routine: puppy, adoption, foster, boarding, training, travel, booster, reaction follow-up, appointment, or longer-term history. The form fields vary by purpose, so review the preview before downloading.
Choose US Letter or A4, portrait or landscape, and color or black-and-white. The travel organizer is for notes and preparation only; it is not an official health or travel certificate.

title: Tournament Bracket
summary: Choose from 100 seeded single-elimination tournament brackets for 4 to 64 teams. Download PDF, Image, Word, or Excel files in color or black-and-white.
lead: Choose your team count and bracket layout, then record each result on the path to a champion.
usage_paragraphs: Enter participants in the seeded opening positions and carry each winner into the connected next-round box. A bye advances a participant without a played game.

The fillable PDF and static Image preserve the supplied printable layout. Word offers an editable bracket. Excel uses Setup for seeded names and Results for scores, then automatically advances winners to Bracket. Equal scores require an A or B tie-winner choice.
selection_guide: Choose the number of participants first. Brackets with 6, 10, 12, or 24 teams include byes to complete the opening round.
Choose a visual layout and color or black-and-white treatment. Preview the full page before downloading, particularly for the denser 32- and 64-team brackets.

items.title: 4-Team Stadium Trophy Bracket
items.summary: A central trophy separates the two sides of the bracket under a bold stadium-style heading. This 4-team single-elimination layout uses navy with cyan and gold accents.
items.intro: A central trophy separates the two sides of the bracket under a bold stadium-style heading. This 4-team single-elimination layout uses navy with cyan and gold accents.
items.alt: 4-team stadium trophy tournament bracket in navy with cyan and gold, with seeded match boxes and a champion space.
description_paragraphs: Enter the 4 participants in the seeded opening positions, then write each winner in the connected box for the next round. The path ends at the champion box after 2 rounds and 3 played games. Every opening position has an opponent, so no first-round byes are needed.

A central trophy separates the two sides of the bracket under a bold stadium-style heading. This US Letter landscape version uses navy with cyan and gold styling with event, date, and venue spaces. Use the fillable PDF or static Image for a printable bracket, or edit the bracket in Word. In Excel, enter names on Setup and scores on Results; formulas advance winners to the Bracket sheet. For tied scores, choose A or B as the tie winner.

title: Printable Protractor
summary: Browse 100 printable protractor designs, including semicircular, full-circle, compass, corner, drafting, and polar layouts. Download matching PDF and Image files in US Letter or A4.
lead: Choose an angle scale and page layout, then print and check the scale before measuring.
usage_paragraphs: Choose the scale for the job: a semicircle for a half turn, a full circle for a complete turn, a compass layout for clockwise bearings from north, or a corner layout for a quadrant.

Use the downloaded PDF for measurement printing. Match its stated paper size and orientation, select 100% / Actual Size, and turn off Fit to Page. Verify both sides of the 20 × 20 mm control square with a ruler before measuring.
selection_guide: Choose the instrument type first. Ruler-base, window, and fine-scale layouts use semicircular scales; full-circle and compass layouts cover a full turn. Polar layouts add rings and radial guides.

Drafting sets combine several instruments, twin layouts offer two semicircular tools, and half-and-full sets combine a semicircle with a disc. Then choose US Letter or A4, portrait or landscape, and color or black-and-white.
For overlay work, use suitable tracing paper or carefully trim an open-window design while preserving its center, baseline, and degree scale. White areas printed on ordinary paper remain opaque.

print_note.title: Print at Actual Size
print_note.intro: Check the printed scale before measuring.

steps.title: Match the Page
steps.text: Open the downloaded PDF and select the paper size and orientation stated on the page.

steps.title: Use 100% / Actual Size
steps.text: Turn off Fit to Page, Shrink, and other automatic scaling. Actual Size prints without changing the page scale.

steps.title: Check Both Sides
steps.text: Measure the horizontal and vertical sides of the 20 × 20 mm control square with a ruler. Both must be 20 mm. If either differs, correct the print settings and reprint before measuring.

title: 90-Day Employee Evaluation
summary: Explore 100 employee evaluation forms for first-quarter reviews, feedback, readiness, and next steps. PDF and Word contain the complete form; each Image shows the first page.
lead: Choose a review format for the conversation, evidence, and next steps that matter to your team.
usage_paragraphs: Start with the employee and review details, then use the prompts to record specific observations, work examples, and agreed next steps. Choose a form suited to the role and the purpose of the review.
PDF and Word contain the complete form. The Image is the first page only. Google Docs is supplied as a downloadable shortcut to the online document and may require a Google account and access.
selection_guide: Choose a review focus and the page length that fits your discussion. Short forms cover an individual conversation; longer packets provide space for more evidence and follow-up.
Color forms appear first; use Print Style to select black-and-white layouts. The preview shows the first page, while the PDF and Word downloads contain the complete form.

title: Printable Ruler
summary: Explore printable metric, inch, dual-unit, center-zero, grid, seam, and full-length rulers.
lead: Choose a scale and page size, then check the printed dimensions before measuring.
selection_guide: Choose metric, fractional-inch, dual-unit, or center-zero scales for the task. Grid, seam, pocket, and full-length layouts offer different ways to measure and mark.
Select US Letter or A4 and the stated orientation, then print the PDF at 100% / Actual Size and check the calibration square.
usage_paragraphs: Use the PDF for controlled printing. Select its stated paper size and orientation, choose 100% / Actual Size, and disable Fit to Page or Shrink.
Before measuring, use an accurate ruler to check both sides of the 20 × 20 mm control square. If either side differs, correct the print settings and print again.

print_note.title: Print at Actual Size

steps.title: Match the Page

steps.text: Turn off Fit to Page, Shrink, and automatic scaling.

steps.title: Check Both Sides
steps.text: Measure both sides of the 20 × 20 mm control square with a ruler. Each side must be 20 mm. If not, correct the settings and print again before measuring.

title: 5 Whys Worksheets
summary: Explore 100 5 Whys worksheets for investigating process, service, business, and operational problems.
lead: Choose a worksheet for your issue, trace the causes, and record evidence and follow-up actions.
selection_guide: Choose a worksheet matching the situation you want to investigate, then select a page layout and print style. Each design has five linked questions and action follow-up fields.
The fifth answer is a starting point for verification, not automatic proof of a root cause. Follow the evidence and investigate additional branches when needed.
usage_paragraphs: Describe the observed problem, answer each why in sequence, and record evidence supporting the chain. Verify the cause before deciding on an action.
The PDF has fillable fields. Word and Photoshop provide editable source layouts; install the included fonts as needed. The Image is a static preview.

selection_guide: Choose a form for the type of communication and select your paper size, layout, and print style. Each template organizes information into Situation, Background, Assessment, and Recommendation.

title: Apology Letter Templates
summary: Find apology letters for customer service, work, personal, education, and community situations.
lead: Choose an apology letter suited to your situation and make the message your own.
selection_guide: Choose a letter that reflects the situation, then select a color or black-and-white design. Each letter includes a subject, an apology, and a proposed follow-up.
Replace bracketed placeholders with your own details and check that any promise or proposed resolution is accurate before sending.
usage_paragraphs: Edit the names, dates, circumstances, proposed resolution, and contact details to reflect what actually happened. Review the letter and its commitments before sharing it.

The PDF contains editable fields; Word provides an editable document, and Image is a static page. The Google Docs shortcut requires access to the source document, which depends on its sharing settings.

title: Ant Identification Charts
summary: Explore ant specimen photographs, comparison charts, and field notes for selected species and anatomical features.
lead: Compare specimen photos, body features, habitats, and regional context with these educational charts.
selection_guide: Choose an overview, a side-by-side comparison, a species profile, or an anatomy and habitat chart. The first page is available as an Image; the PDF contains field notes and reference credits.
Compare multiple features with a current regional identification key. Images, color, and location alone may not confirm a species.
usage_paragraphs: The first page compares specimen photographs and descriptive features. Further PDF pages contain field notes, supporting references, and photograph credits. Print on A3 for the intended reading size; smaller paper reduces text and image size.

These charts include third-party photographs with individual Creative Commons licenses and credits. Review each PDF’s source and photograph-credit pages for the applicable attribution, license terms, and image modifications. Image is the first page only.

items.title: Household Ant Explorer - Ant Identification Chart
items.summary: Six familiar visitors, six different diagnostic signatures.
items.intro: Six familiar visitors, six different diagnostic signatures.
items.alt: Household Ant Explorer, an ant identification chart with labeled specimen photos and comparison notes.
description_paragraphs: The first page shows labeled specimen photographs for Black carpenter ant, Argentine ant, Odorous house ant, Ghost ant, Pharaoh ant, Immigrant pavement ant. Start with a side view. Count waist nodes before comparing color or nesting clues.
The 3-page PDF adds field notes and source and photograph credits. Compare several traits and a regional identification key; the images alone may not establish a species.

title: Horse Bill of Sale Forms
selection_title: Which Horse Bill of Sale Should I Choose?
summary: Choose a horse sale form for identity and registration details, health-record references, equipment, handover, or a specific use and history.
lead: Select the form that fits the horse and the records or handover details you want to document. Each design keeps party, identity, and transaction fields together.
selection_guide: Browse forms for identification and registration, examinations and health-record references, pickup or boarding, tack and equipment, riding history, life stage, and other disclosed details. The heading names the particular scenario and the record section to review.

Check the horse’s identifying details, the parties’ ownership statements, included or excluded property, health and examination references, price, handover, and signatures. Health fields record information provided by the parties; they do not establish veterinary findings, soundness, or suitability.
usage_paragraphs: Complete the horse’s name, registry or identification details, markings, and any microchip or age information the parties know. Use the dedicated record section for the listed scenario and identify supporting documents by date or reference.

PDFs contain fillable fields; Word and ODT are editable; the Image is a first-page preview. Health and examination sections are for recording references, not a veterinary certification. Confirm local ownership-transfer, health-document, and signing requirements with qualified local sources.

title: Livestock Bill of Sale Forms
selection_title: Which Livestock Bill of Sale Should I Choose?
summary: Find livestock sale forms for cattle, sheep, goats, pigs, and chickens, with space for individual animals or lots and the records that accompany a transfer.
lead: Select a form for the species, sale group, and records involved. Each three-page design includes animal or lot identification, party and ownership details, transaction terms, and a focused record section.
selection_guide: The collection covers cattle, sheep, goats, pigs, and chickens, including individual animals and lots. Dedicated sections address details such as breeding or age records, weights, tags and identification, health or vaccination references, transport, feed, delivery, and group inventories. Use the heading to find the species and transaction record that match your situation.

The forms provide fields for the parties, animal or lot identification, species and breed as represented, head count, age or date-of-birth basis, management and health-record references when applicable, ownership statements, price, delivery, and signatures. These forms record information supplied by the parties; they do not certify an animal's health, vaccination, pedigree, or regulatory status. Check applicable brand, movement, health certificate, and local sale requirements before transfer.
usage_paragraphs: Identify each animal or lot using the sale reference, tag or animal ID, species, breed as represented, count, and other details requested. Keep group totals consistent across any attached inventory and use the dedicated fields for the listed weight, breeding, health, vaccination, transport, or delivery record.

PDFs include fillable fields; Word and ODT versions are editable; the Image is a preview of page one. Review all three pages, list supporting documents by date or reference, and confirm applicable movement, inspection, brand, and signing requirements with the relevant local authorities.

title: Equipment Bill of Sale Forms
selection_title: Which Equipment Bill of Sale Should I Choose?
summary: Compare equipment sale forms for excavators, forklifts, generators, air compressors, and workshop machinery, including attachments and operating or service records.
lead: Choose a form for the machine and the included attachments or records. Each two-page design captures equipment identity, parties, ownership statements, sale terms, and a focused equipment or service schedule.
selection_guide: The collection includes excavators, forklifts, generators, air compressors, and metalworking or workshop machines. Dedicated sections cover attachments, bucket or fork inventories, batteries and chargers, hour-meter readings, service or repair records, inspection findings, transport, and other named equipment details. Select the machine type and record section that match the property being transferred.

The two-page forms provide fields for year, make, model, manufacturer serial number or PIN, equipment type and configuration, power source, rated capacity, displayed hours or cycles, condition or meter history, ownership statements, sale terms, and signatures. List included and excluded attachments clearly. The form records party-provided details and does not certify condition, safety, performance, or ownership. Verify applicable tax, lien, and transfer requirements for the equipment and location.
usage_paragraphs: Enter the parties and the equipment identifiers, type, configuration, power source, rated capacity, and displayed hours or cycles requested. Describe each included attachment and identify any exclusions. Use the dedicated fields for the form's bucket, battery, service, inspection, transport, or other equipment record.

PDFs include fillable fields; Word and ODT versions are editable; the Image is a preview of page one. Check that serial numbers and attachment schedules match the machine and review both pages before signing. Confirm any applicable lien, tax, safety, or local transfer requirements separately.

title: Bank Reconciliation Workpapers
summary: Choose from 100 bank reconciliation workpapers for account close, deposits, payroll, foreign currency, trust activity, and exception follow-up. Each includes an editable Word workpaper, a formula-supported Excel workbook, and a first-page Image preview.
lead: Match the workpaper to the cash activity, statement cutoff, and supporting evidence you need to reconcile.
usage_paragraphs: Choose the workpaper that matches the account activity and review task. Keep the bank statement and book cash records on the same account, currency, and period-end cutoff; use masked account identifiers in supporting schedules.

The Excel workbook includes formulas and separate supporting tabs. Check its formulas and totals against source records before relying on the results. The Word version is a printable workpaper with manual totals; the Image download is the first page only.

Record timing differences, book adjustments, bank correspondence, and approvals with traceable references. These workpapers support reconciliation documentation and do not replace your organization’s accounting policies or independent review.
selection_guide: Choose the subject and close task first: the collection includes deposit tracing, payment proof, branch and account controls, payroll funding, client trust, foreign-currency balances, transfers, bank exceptions, and close review. Read each design’s short description to identify its specific focus.
Every workpaper is US Letter portrait. The first 70 designs are black and white; the final 30 are color. Page counts vary from 7 to 10 pages.

Each design has a Word workpaper with manual totals, a companion Excel workbook with formulas, and an Image of page 1. Select a different page count or workpaper type in the finder; the Image is for preview and does not contain the full multipage document.

title: Bar Graph Templates
selection_title: How to Choose a Bar Graph Template
summary: Choose from 100 bar graph designs for sales, marketing, budgets, operations, education, and community reporting. Each includes a two-page Word report, an editable Excel chart with a Data sheet, and an Image preview of page one.
lead: Compare the chart style and sample topic, then make each layout your own with its editable Excel data sheet.
usage_paragraphs: Each design includes a two-page Word report, an Excel workbook with Chart and Data sheets, and an Image preview of page one. Update labels and values on the Excel Data sheet to refresh its linked chart and formula-supported summaries.

The sample charts use illustrative values that should be replaced with verified data before sharing. Designs 001–075 are in color; 076–100 are black and white. Eight blank practice grids are included: 072–075 and 097–100.
The Image download shows only page one. The complete two-page Word report contains its working-data table and reading notes; the Excel workbook provides editable source data and a linked chart.
selection_guide: Use the Chart Style filter to compare horizontal bar and vertical column layouts, including grouped and stacked versions. Color is available on designs 001–075; designs 076–100 use black and white. Choose the style that makes your categories and series easiest to compare.

Most sheets contain illustrative example data; replace the values and confirm units, labels, period, and source before presenting results. The eight blank grids (072–075 and 097–100) are ready for your own categories and values. The Image is page one only; download the Word or Excel file for the editable material.

title: DuPont Shift Schedule Templates
summary: Choose among 100 four-crew shift schedule designs for rotation planning, staffing, leave coverage, time records, handovers, and reconciliation. Each includes editable Excel and Word files, a complete printable PDF, and a WebP preview of page one.
lead: Choose a view for the planning task, schedule horizon, or print style. Confirm the anchor date, crew phases, local shift times, and workplace rules before using a file for live coverage.
usage_paragraphs: The provided rotation follows a continuous 28-day pattern for four crews: four nights, three off, three days, one off, three nights, three off, four days, then seven off. The crew phases are offset by 0, 7, 14, and 21 days. Across a complete cycle, the baseline assigns each crew seven day shifts, seven night shifts, and 14 off dates; 168 hours is the nominal full-cycle total, averaging 42 hours per week across the cycle, not every calendar week.

A date marks the shift start. A night shift continues into the following morning; an off date means no new shift starts and does not cancel a night already in progress. The rotation continues across month and year boundaries. Many sample views begin in January 2027. Replace the illustrative records and use a verified anchor date before relying on any dates or assignments.

Each Excel workbook has five tabs: Schedule, Setup, Worksheet, Changes, and Rotation. Update the Setup inputs for the crew names, first night in Crew A’s four-night block, display date, and day-shift start. Only approved whole-crew entries on Changes alter the baseline schedule; these entries do not automatically move an individual employee between crews.

The templates calculate nominal schedule hours, not payroll, statutory overtime, rest-period compliance, or labor-agreement compliance. They do not adjust for daylight-saving transitions automatically. Confirm staffing, local rules, employer agreements, shift start times, and any required approvals before operational use. Sample values are illustrative. Office files were structurally checked but not interactively tested in desktop Microsoft Excel or Word.
“DuPont schedule” is a commonly used name for this rotation pattern. TemplateAtlas is an independent publisher and is not affiliated with or endorsed by DuPont de Nemours, Inc.
selection_guide: Use the Schedule Horizon filter to choose the 28-day, 56-day, 84-day, monthly, annual, or adjacent-month view. Planning Areas group designs for core scheduling, people and roles, leave and relief, change management, hours and time, skills and training, operations and handover, coordination, field records, and review.

The first 80 designs use color and the final 20 use standard black-and-white layouts. Each Image download is the first page only; the PDF and Word files contain the complete document, and the Excel workbook contains the editable schedule and task-specific worksheet.

title: Cornell Notes Templates
summary: Explore 100 one-page Cornell Notes worksheets for lectures, reading, research, STEM, study skills, and workplace learning. Each has a matching editable Word file, a fillable PDF, and a WebP preview; 50 designs are ink-friendly Standard and 50 use color.
lead: Choose a subject or activity, then compare the Standard and Color layouts.
usage_paragraphs: These are purpose-built study worksheets rather than 100 copies of one blank page. Prompts and response areas vary across lecture notes, close reading, research, science, math, language, work, and spaced recall.

Standard designs use black-and-white printing; Color designs use topic-specific color. Every PDF is a one-page fillable form, every Word file is editable, and each WebP is the corresponding first-page preview.
Use the prompts to retrieve or explain an idea before checking the source, then record what needs clarification. Health Studies pages are educational study aids, not clinical guidance.
selection_guide: Filter by subject and activity to find a page for the work at hand. Each one-page layout has its own questions and labeled response areas, so compare the preview before choosing.
Standard is the ink-friendly black-and-white edition; Color uses color illustration and emphasis. PDF is fillable, Word is editable, and WebP is a static preview of the same page.

title: Nursing Notes Templates
summary: Browse 100 blank nursing note templates for admissions, assessments, shift handoffs, procedures, patient education, and care transitions. Every design includes a fillable PDF, editable Word file, first-page Image preview, and a font package; 20 Standard black-and-white and 80 Color designs.
lead: Filter by care area, page layout, or print style, then open a preview before choosing a note.
usage_paragraphs: These blank note formats organize documentation fields; they do not establish clinical criteria, direct treatment, or replace your organization’s approved charting procedures.

Keep patient identifiers and health information in approved secure records, not on TemplateAtlas. Confirm that a selected layout meets your organization’s documentation and privacy requirements before use.
selection_guide: Filter the collection by care area, page orientation, or print style. Each card shows its page count; open the first-page preview to inspect the labels and writing areas before downloading.

Standard designs are black and white; Color designs use color accents and illustrations. Each note includes a fillable PDF, editable Word document, a WebP preview of page 1, and the packaged typefaces with their license.

print_note.title: Print at the Intended Size
print_note.intro: These pages are designed for US Letter paper. Match the orientation shown in the preview.

steps.title: Choose US Letter
steps.text: Select US Letter paper and the matching portrait or landscape orientation.

steps.title: Use Actual Size
steps.text: Print at 100% / Actual Size and turn off “Fit to Page” so the page keeps its intended proportions.

title: Late Rent Notice & Rent Reminder Templates
summary: Browse 100 US Letter rent correspondence templates for past-due rent reminders, payment records, account reconciliation, repayment plans, commercial rent, and selected state-specific samples. Each design includes an editable Word document, a fillable PDF, a page-one WebP preview, and a licensed font bundle. The package contains 80 Standard black-and-white and 20 Color designs.
lead: Compare the page-one previews, then choose a rent reminder, account record, payment-plan letter, or state-specific sample that fits the document you need.
usage_paragraphs: These blank layouts are correspondence and recordkeeping templates, not legal advice, legal determinations, or official government or court forms. State-specific samples are not approved statutory notices and do not replace required forms or service procedures. Requirements can depend on the property, lease, federal or local protections, housing program, and current state and local law. Check current official sources and consult a qualified housing attorney before relying on a notice or deadline.

Before sending a rent-related document, reconcile the lease and ledger, posted payments, credits, assistance, permitted charges, names, rental periods, and payment instructions. Keep tenant records secure. A WebP is only the first-page preview; download the complete PDF or Word file to view every page. The included font bundle carries its font license.
selection_guide: Filter by template type, page count, or print style. The 100 designs cover rent reminders and statements, reconciliation and tracing, plans and support, commercial rent, lease transitions, and state-specific correspondence. Read each card’s short use description and field list; the page-one preview does not show continuation pages.

Every design includes a fillable PDF, an editable Word DOCX, a WebP preview of page 1, and a font ZIP with its license. Standard designs are black and white; Color designs use color styling. Download the full document before use and verify its contents and intended recipients.

description_paragraphs: Use when a signed substitution or novation specifies the effective date and rent responsibility. Limit the demand to the recipient’s verified period and do not allocate another tenant’s debts. The page is organized as a lease transitions layout for this rent-account situation.

The form labels include Rent under the substitution agreement, Agreement date, Substitution effective date, Period assigned to you, Rent for that period ($), Payments credited ($), Unpaid rent ($). It is a 1-page US Letter portrait design in color style. The WebP shows page 1; download the complete PDF or editable Word file to view and use every page.
